sourceFinding.explanation: The generic contextv7 capture intentionally preserves nonempty original request bodies, while the fixed POST checkpoint consumer requires an empty body. The native client's old prepare path used only the generic capture before its real preparer, so its fixed-body admission check was missing at that source boundary.

nativeClientConnection.sourceOrder: fixed route/body capture -> existing official-asset guard -> actual prepareOriginalFunding entry
